_comment: Linked services for the MedChain Data Factory. Authentication is by managed identity throughout — the factory's system-assigned identity is granted Storage Blob Data Contributor by infra/provision.sh, and Contributor on the Databricks workspace. No keys, connection strings or secrets appear in these definitions, which is what makes them safe to commit.

Databricks job compute. New job clusters rather than an all-purpose cluster: job DBUs cost roughly half the all-purpose rate, and the cluster terminates when the run ends instead of idling.
